instruction: That gives us separate targets for improving passage discovery and proving an answer from prose. Lets walk that path and devise a pattern rule
scope: Accept a complete natural date inventory form with explicit role and site guardrails. Reuse the existing proof kernel and preserve the full policy question.
Add a separate bounded named-summary passage probe and a way to refresh the retained graph evaluation baseline against a new native revision.
validation: An independently worded fictional harbour example failed on the old grammar and passed after the repair. Focused regression tests cover scope additions, mismatched targets, reported events, calendar limits and competing sources.

The unchanged original 22 had identical native contracts except code hashes. Exactly one of the 40 follow-up answers changed. The Fort Sumter paraphrase moved from abstention to supported with all reference anchors. The ten boundary questions kept full support withheld.

All 52 public evidence controls passed with zero falsely supported bridges. The graph comparison reran on 52 new and follow-up rows. The Apollo 13 explicit-summary probe recovered the reference passage under the ordinary passage and character caps.
limitations: The named-summary lookup is an experimental discovery path with no automatic proof use. Only the explicit section case was recovered in the Apollo pair.
Retained results cover frozen development questions and known originals. Independent historical semantic review was not run.
next_steps: Collect independently written date-role requests and multiple well-formed section fixtures to test transfer. Keep Apollo causal proof separate from section discovery.
